problems.title: Severe Water Logging near Central Market Gate 2
problems.description: The road is flooded with knee-deep water after the heavy rain. Vehicles are stuck and pedestrians are unable to cross. Needs immediate local municipality attention or drainage support.
problems.author: Dev Rawat

solutions.author: Vikram Singh
solutions.text: Avoid taking the Gate 2 route. The traffic police has diverted cars through the flyover bypass.

solutions.author: Helpingo AI Agent
solutions.text:
🚨 Emergency Water Logging Protocol: 
1. Do not wade through floodwaters as they might be electrically charged or contaminated.
2. We have logged this report to the municipal helpline (#44921).
3. Use the flyover bypass route.

problems.title: Looking for volunteer tutors for local orphanage education camp
problems.description: We are organizing a 2-week basic science & mathematics study camp for kids at the Asha Children's Home. Looking for high school/college students who can volunteer 2 hours a day.
problems.author: Neha Sharma

solutions.author: Neha Sharma
solutions.text: I am a college biology major. I would love to volunteer for the science sessions! Please let me know the contact process.

problems.title: Lost my folder containing academic certificates near Central Library
problems.description: I lost a blue plastic folder containing my 10th and 12th board certificates and college transcripts. Probably dropped it around the parking lot or cafeteria. Extremely urgent!
problems.author: Vikram Singh

solutions.author: Rajesh Kumar
solutions.text: Check with the Lost & Found desk inside the main library lobby. They keep items found in the cafeteria there.

problems.title: High voltage electricity line sparking continuously
problems.description: The overhead cable near sector 4 crossing is sparking badly due to a tree branch leaning on it. Risk of fire or short circuit. Electric board needs to trim the tree branch and fix the wire.
problems.author: Dev Rawat

solutions.author: Electric Grid Officer
solutions.text: Line has been shut down, branches cleared, and wire insulated. Status marked resolved.
